summary: Part 1 of the 1.1 Seller Onboarding video (00:00 to 06:24). Pierre introduces Revibe on three slide screens (the 'Welcome to Revibe' title slide, the 'Revibe presentation' slide and the 'Onboarding process' slides), then opens the Seller Onboarding App (AppSheet, in Google Chrome) and fills in the New Slice Form for the seller profile, using the Revibe Dubai office address as the example. The last frame (06:20, t00380) shows the platforms question still empty; the form is not saved on screen in this part.

unclear.issue: Speech says Revibe offers customers one year of warranty and that the seller supports the first six months (01:22). Slide 2 shows only the seller's 6 months warranty for valid claims. The one-year figure is not on screen, so it is not stated as a fact.

Trainer says 'Mention your Emirates if you're in the UAE' right after the phone line. The Phone field shows only '+' and the spoken instruction is unclear, so it is not stated what to enter beyond the phone number.

Trainer says 'you will get onboarded once the onboarding is done' (03:27), while the slides place an ONBOARDING tag above step 3 (trial period, t00227.jpg; also t00248.jpg). It is unclear whether the onboarded status starts at the trial period or at full onboarding.
Trainer names Amazon as the platform example, but the 'On which platforms ?' field is still empty in the last frame (t00380.jpg, 06:20). It is unclear whether Amazon was actually selected.
'between {in?} 20 and 30 products' is marked low-confidence and is said as an example ('let's say'); it is not a rule.
The 100 dirhams payment example is spoken only; the currency and amount are not on screen. Treated as an example, not as a rule for prices.

Frame t00357 (05:57) shows the Google Maps link already marked COPIÉ DANS LE PRESSE-PAPIERS, while frame t00361 (06:01) shows the pre-copy COPIER LE LIEN state with the cursor on the Partager icon. The exact copy sequence cannot be confirmed from these frames.

outdated.signal: 'We currently operate in three countries' and 'At the moment' phrasing: time-bound claim about current operations.
'At the moment, we receive more than 12,000 orders on a monthly basis after only two years' (also slide 2 '12k monthly orders'): figure is as of recording.
'growing ... 25% every month on average' (slide 2 '+25% growth each month'): growth rate is time-bound.
The Mac menu bar clock shows 'Jeu. 7 août' (recording date) on the app screens. The AppSheet form and its fields may have changed since then; check the live app before relying on the field list.

privacy.what: Presenter's full name spoken aloud ('my name is Pierre Villasek') and nationality ('I'm French'). Not on screen; spelling of the surname cannot be checked from the frames. Presenter data, not a seller's, but personal and spoken.
Email field on screen shows a personal-looking Gmail address 'iam.pepemanagement@gmail.com' (pre-filled from the logged-in account). Do not share this frame without masking the email.
Introduction video thumbnail shows an admin 'Orders' table. At this resolution the cells are not readable, so no customer names or contact details are confirmed; check before sharing.
